articles.title: BPSC TRE-4.0 2026: Recruitment announced for 32,388 Bihar teacher posts, applications from September 1
articles.summary: BPSC has announced TRE-4.0, the fourth phase of Bihar’s school teacher recruitment drive, with 32,388 vacancies under the Education Department. Online applications will open on September 1, 2026, while fee payment closes on September 29 and applications on September 30.

articles.title: Maharashtra B. Arch second list offers admission to 728 new students; 893 secure preferred colleges statewide
articles.summary: Maharashtra State Common Entrance Test Cell has released the second B.Architecture admission list for 2026-27, offering admission opportunities to 728 new students from 2,007 candidates. A total of 893 students received one of their first three preferred colleges under Auto freeze.

articles.title: Puducherry schools holiday on August 21 and 22: Check the list and reason
articles.summary: The Education Department in Puducherry has announced holidays on August 21 and August 22 for 69 government and private schools selected as examination centres for the Integrated Graduate Level Examination. The examination will be conducted from August 21 to August 23.

articles.title: 'Awarapan 2' box office collection day 5: Emraan delivers the first Rs 100 crore solo lead film
articles.summary: Emraan Hashmi's sequel 'Awarapan 2' has successfully hit the Rs 100 crore milestone in India, achieving this impressive feat just five days post-release. After a strong opening day with Rs 22 crore, the film experienced substantial growth over the weekend.

articles.title: 12.5 percent growth on Day 5 over Monday: Sunny Deol's 'Batwara 1947' crosses Rs 30 crore
articles.summary: Batwara 1947's box office journey shows a sharp downward turn. The film collected approximately thirty crore rupees after five days.

articles.title: 'Thudakkam' BO day 12: Movie earns Rs 49 lakhs
articles.summary: Vismaya Mohanlal's debut film 'Thudakkam' experienced a minor earnings decrease on its twelfth day. The movie has now accumulated over twenty-one crore rupees in domestic net collections.

articles.title: CCTV footage shows Hayden with boyfriend hours before death
